original_description: TrackGleam helps musicians, producers, podcasters and AI-music creators finish songs for release. Share a track or its numbers and get a plain-English read of what is holding it back - loudness versus streaming level, clipping, muddy low mids, harsh highs, stereo problems - with practical targets for Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube and TikTok. When a tool can do the job, the plugin gives you a TrackGleam link that opens with a suggested starting style: free automatic mastering with WAV and MP3 downloads, a vocal-over-a-beat mixer, a Spotify Canvas maker, a music visualizer for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, a cover art maker and release-check tools. TrackGleam processes your audio in your own browser; your song is not uploaded. The plugin does not master or export files inside ChatGPT.
summary_ja: 楽曲の音量や音質の確認と公開準備を支援し、外部の制作ツールへ案内する。
limitations: ChatGPT内でのマスタリングや書き出しは行わない。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
